topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and tissue damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how pattern recognition receptors and downstream signaling complexes detect microbial products and cellular damage to initiate immune responses.

topics.label: Sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte trafficking into tissues and the lymphatic system, as well as the risks of systemic inflammatory overactivation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms that terminate inflammatory responses, the pathways of tissue healing, and the physiological roles of chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic of the next lecture.
